name: Urban Audit: cities and greater cities

measures.definition: Share of journeys to work made by bus, tram, metro or train, as reported by the city.
Average time of a journey to work, one way.
Share of residents born in another country: a measure of how international the city is.
Share of the city's area that is green urban space or sports and leisure land, from the EU Urban Atlas via Eurostat.
Public swimming pools, indoor and outdoor, per 100,000 residents, as reported by the city to the Eurostat Urban Audit.
People killed in road accidents per 10,000 residents a year.
Price of a monthly pass for all public transport in the central zone (5 to 10 km).
Share of people aged 25 to 64 whose highest level of education is tertiary (ISCED 5 to 8), reported by the city; figures from 2014 on only.
Share of journeys to work made on foot plus the share made by bicycle, from the same year.

rights.edition: Urban Audit tables urb_c*, each city's latest value 2011-2025
rights.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Urban Audit (© European Union). Borgo keeps each city's latest value and converts units where its note says so
notices: Eurostat is not responsible for Borgo's use of its data.

vetted.notes: Each city's latest report; older than 2010 dropped.

caveats: A place is found by its name among the Urban Audit's city labels, which use local names (Torino, Wien, Athina): a place known here only by its English name may not be found.
